description: React component for managing permission groups in Mattermost admin console, including permission toggling, scope filtering, and rendering permission rows and subgroups.

classes.name: PermissionGroup
classes.description: React component class for permission group management with recursive permission handling, scope filtering, and UI rendering.

methods.name: getRecursivePermissions
methods.description: Recursively collects all permission strings from nested permissions structure.

methods.name: toggleExpanded
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of the permission group in UI.

methods.name: toggleSelectRow
methods.description: Handles selection of individual permission row.

methods.name: toggleSelectSubGroup
methods.description: Handles selection of a subgroup of permissions.

methods.name: toggleSelectGroup
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of the entire permission group, updating permissions accordingly.

methods.name: isInScope
methods.description: Checks if a permission is within the current scope (channel or team).

methods.name: renderPermission
methods.description: Renders a permission row if within scope.

methods.name: fromParent
methods.description: Determines if a permission is inherited from parent role.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Determines the checkbox status ('checked', 'intermediate', or '') for permissions.

methods.name: hasPermissionsOnScope
methods.description: Checks if any permissions are within the current scope.

methods.name: allPermissionsFromParent
methods.description: Checks if all permissions are inherited from parent role.
